final: WITH total AS (SELECT SUM(traitcount) AS n FROM scanfeatures), shares AS (SELECT f.zoneref, f.traitcount, 1.0 * f.traitcount / NULLIF(total.n, 0) AS share FROM scanfeatures AS f CROSS JOIN total WHERE total.n IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM shares) SELECT s.zoneref, s.traitcount, s.share, s.share - m.mean_share AS difference FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN mean_share AS m WHERE m.mean_share IS NOT NULL AND s.share > m.mean_share ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
